tagline: One of the largest franchised automotive retailers in the United States with diversified revenue streams across new vehicles, used vehicles, parts and services, and finance and insurance products
hero_kpi_rationale: Key performance indicator reflecting overall business growth and the impact of the strategic acquisition of Herb Chambers in 2025, the primary financial event of the year

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated revenue including all operations (new vehicles, used vehicles, parts and services, finance and insurance)
kpis.description: Total company revenue for 2025, higher compared to 2024 primarily due to the acquisition of Herb Chambers

kpis.name: Consolidated Gross Profit
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated gross profit across all business segments
kpis.description: Total consolidated gross profit for 2025, increased due to growth in service and parts and the acquisition of Herb Chambers

kpis.name: New Vehicle Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of new vehicles, representing the majority of operations
kpis.description: Primary revenue stream of the company, composed of 40% imports, 32% luxury brands, and 28% domestic brands in 2025

kpis.name: Used Vehicle Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the retail sale of used vehicles and wholesale auction sales
kpis.description: Secondary revenue stream including sales to individual customers (used retail) and wholesale auctions

kpis.name: Parts and Service Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from repair services, maintenance, spare parts, and collision repair
kpis.description: Growing complementary revenue stream including repair, maintenance, spare parts sales, and collision services

kpis.name: Finance and Insurance Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by Total Care Auto (TCA) and automotive financing and insurance activities
kpis.description: Complementary revenue including extended service contracts, GAP, prepaid maintenance, and aesthetic protection

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Ratio of gross profit to total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin of 17.06% in 2025, slightly lower than 2024 due to reduced margins on new vehicles from historically high levels

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Ratio of operating profit to total revenue
kpis.description: Indicator of the company's operational profitability

kpis.name: Number of dealership locations
kpis.explanation: Total number of operational dealership locations
kpis.description: 171 dealership locations operating 223 franchises representing 36 automotive brands across 15 states

kpis.name: New Vehicle Franchises
kpis.explanation: Total number of operated new vehicle franchises
kpis.description: 223 franchises representing 36 automotive brands, including the acquisition of Herb Chambers in July 2025

kpis.name: Collision Centers
kpis.explanation: Total number of operational repair and collision centers
kpis.description: 39 collision centers operated as an integral part of the full-service network

kpis.name: Herb Chambers Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Strategic acquisition of 33 dealership locations and 3 collision centers for $1.76 billion
kpis.description: Major acquisition completed on July 21, 2025, to strengthen the group's position and expand its geographic footprint and brand portfolio

kpis.name: Franchise Divestitures
kpis.explanation: Disposal of 24 franchises representing 15 dealership locations in 2025
kpis.description: 24 franchises divested (15 dealership locations) generating $436.3 million in revenue in 2025

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Share repurchase program to return capital to shareholders
kpis.description: Repurchased 432,752 shares for $99.9 million in 2025, reflecting the capital return policy

risks.title: Competition in vehicle sales
risks.score_rationale: The company faces increased competition in the vehicle sales sector, which could impact its sales volumes and profit margins in a fragmented market environment.

risks.title: Regulatory and environmental risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to growing government regulations and environmental standards, which could affect its operations, operating costs, and financing capabilities.

risks.title: Decline in new vehicle sales
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to a potential decline in new vehicle sales due to macroeconomic conditions, consumer preferences, and structural changes in the automotive industry.

risks.title: Supply chain and vehicle availability risks
risks.score_rationale: The company remains exposed to supply chain risks, including the availability of key parts and components, which impact new vehicle inventory levels at certain manufacturers.

risks.title: Debt and financing risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant debt, including financing lines used for the acquisition of Herb Chambers, which could affect its financial flexibility and repayment capacity.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and trade tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Demand is sensitive to interest rates, inflation, energy prices, and potential recession. Announced tariffs in January 2025 (25% on automobiles) directly threaten the value chain and retail pricing.

risks.title: Reputation and quality risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces reputation risks related to the brands sold and its own services, which could impact customer satisfaction and repeat sales.

risks.title: Technological and digital risks
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on its omni-channel and digital capabilities to engage customers. Technological failures or cybersecurity incidents could impact customer experience and operations.

ai_positioning.summary: ABG does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The company focuses on omni-channel and digital innovation without explicit reference to AI technologies.
